DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Cystic Kidney Disease presenting with hematuria.

I have received your test results showing multiple cysts in the collecting ducts of the medulla and a normal creatinine level. Since we have established the presence of cysts and confirmed renal function, I will conclude this consultation with the diagnosis of Medullary Cystic Kidney Disease as the primary cause of your symptoms.
